title: Royal Potatoes
description: The mod adds a new boss in the form of a huge potato in a crown. The boss is inspired by my friend SIWNA or as I call him "Potato".
body:
Imagine that you have collected four golden apples and wove them with potatoes, creating an amazing object resembling a potato in a crown. This unusual artifact sparkles with magic and is fraught with mystery. But once you try to taste it, a Royal Potato emerges from it — a majestic boss ready to challenge you. Its huge size and impressive strength will make you feel like a tiny bug under the wheel of a royal carriage.

The Royal Potato tends to overwhelm you with its weight and power, but don't be afraid! By fighting him, you will be able to win and earn your reward. For this difficult battle, you will be presented with a Suspicious Potato — a strange but attractive fruit that promises incredible saturation. Just one bite of this potato can cause such a storm of sensations that you risk bursting with excess pleasure!

Immerse yourself in this exciting adventure, where every action you take can lead to unexpected consequences, and every victory brings unique gifts. Who knows what secrets and magic are hidden behind the edges of this amazing world?

The design of the Royal Kortofel was inspired by my friend SIWNA or as we call him "Potato"

A mod from a series of mods - **Kentavrs**
